description: config:recommended ignores **/tests/**; the mini.nvim pin lives in tests/minimal_init.lua, so nothing is ignored here.
Updates come once a week in one group, so bot commits do not bury the commit history. Vulnerability fixes ignore the schedule (Renovate default).
minimumReleaseAge holds each release for 7 days, so a compromised release has time to be found and pulled before CI runs it. Vulnerability fixes skip this wait (Renovate default).

packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates when the required checks pass. Every dependency here is CI or dev tooling, so no update reaches users of the plugin. digest is excluded: for github-tags, a force-pushed tag ages against its original release date, so it passes minimumReleaseAge at once. pinDigest stays: it pins the commit that CI already runs, so no new code comes in.

customManagers.description: mini.nvim tag pinned by the test bootstrap
